Psi4 analytic DFT gradient invoked a MemDFJK response backend despite a DIRECT SCF energy, violating the no-RI/DF contract.

The P03 projection tangent was found to use the wrong fragment axis; it was corrected to frozen axis [0,6] and rotating atoms [1,2,3,4,5,14,15,16,17,18].
Frozen source grid, exact DIRECT Psi4 energies, finite-difference projected/full gradients, and the source-defined P03 rotation axis are all fixed before results are evaluated.
